title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #106 · 매체 믹스 · 대각 띠·매끈 · 5영역(에나멜 컬러블록+유화 임파스토+UV 네온+수채+사이아노타입) · 풀커버 · violin hip hourglass · 정면 팔 내림 · Polynesian · 배경 마추픽추 계단식 터 · 걸크러시
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sleek slicked-back dark brown hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 diagonal bands by 4 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 33% of the way down her figure from the top, about 47% of the way down her figure from the top, about 59% of the way down her figure from the top and about 80% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries high-gloss enamel paint in ruby red and cobalt blue, a mirror-glossy coat with wet-looking highlights. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries thick impasto oil paint in cadmium yellow and viridian, heavy palette-knife ridges catching the light. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries fluorescent UV neon paint in neon pink and acid lime lightning streaks, glowing intensely with a blacklight shimmer. Region 4 is the diagonal band between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries translucent watercolour washes in rose and cerulean with pooled edges and thin downward drips. Region 5 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries deep Prussian-blue cyanotype prints with white fern and leaf silhouettes. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing tall facing the camera straight on, arms relaxed at her sides, weight even on both feet, her legs fully in view — most extreme violin hip hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in white lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: the green stone terraces of Machu Picchu with stone steps of normal height and low terrace walls, empty of tourists, in clear sunny daylight, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
